sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-GGUF is a quantized version of Meta's Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct instruction-tuned model, created by bartowski using llama.cpp release b3821. The model is a 1-billion-parameter language model quantized through imatrix calibration, resulting in files ranging from 0.66GB to 2.48GB depending on quantization method.
